liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cold Rain and Snow** (2 reviews): Reviewer hears Bobby possibly saying something like 'whoa Vince' around the nine-minute mark; Reviewer believes Bobby asked for more Vince in his earbud monitor during this song [13][14]
- **Althea** (2 reviews): Called one of the best Althea versions the reviewer has heard, with Jerry's voice and guitar licks both strong; Reviewer calls the Althea very good [11][13]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Praised as a perfect Tennessee Jed with a great Jerry solo [20]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat into Rider pairing is called fun but not masterful [20]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer finds Looks Like Rain absolutely beautiful [22]
- **Way To Go Home** (1 review): Vince's solo and song here are credited with energizing the band and Jerry's playing [14]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer has always loved the jam coming out of Terrapin [19]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer loves the playful, serious, ethereal drums and space segment from this date [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **Baba O'Reilly**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [23]
- **Tomorrow Never Knows**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 12 archived performances [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-05-19.akg460.swayne.86251.flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 156 min [1]
- **gd1992-05-19.akg.swayne.86238.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 156 min [2]. Said about its sound: Taper finds the recording remarkably clear, with only occasional light breeze noise [2]
- **gd1992-05-19.sbd.wiley.20003.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 160 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Known flaws include static and dropouts at the start of disc one, plus brief static in disc two [3]
- **gd92-05-19.sbd.wiley.7856.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 160 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [4]. Said about its sound: Described as a good-quality soundboard recording [13]
- **gd1992-05-19.150294.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 166 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Jerry faded and struggled through the later part of the show, while Phil stayed strong throughout [11]
- Reviewer thinks the band was trying out new earpiece monitors and learning the communication setup with the soundboard [14]
- Reviewer notes Jerry's health was worsening in 1992 and the band took the fall off for his recovery [20]
- Reviewer says Garcia was not playing well, and criticizes Vince's digital piano sounds and the band dropping the Hammond [21]
- Reviewer says this was the first show after Bruce's time with the band [22]
- The stage lost power for three minutes during Drums [6]
- Second set seemed to build toward a peak that never came; it is subtle and relaxed compared with high-energy classic shows [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-05-19.akg460.swayne.86251.flac1648**: taped by Scott Swayne and Carl S.; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: AKG 460/CK8s (25-foot split) > Tascam DA-P20 [1]
- **gd1992-05-19.akg.swayne.86238.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Scott Swayne and Carl S.; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: AKG 460/CK8s (25-foot split) > Tascam DA-P20 [2]. Also: Two AKG microphones were placed, one on each side of the soundboard, about 25 feet apart [2]
- **gd1992-05-19.sbd.wiley.20003.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Tim Wiley; source: Source A:SBD>DAT>CDR>EAC>Cool Edit>SHN; B:SBD>CM>CDR>EAC>Cool Edit>SHN [3]. Also: Source CDs came from Paul Bottiglio; sector boundary errors were fixed with shntool [3]
- **gd92-05-19.sbd.wiley.7856.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> CDR [4]. Also: Soundboard to DAT to CDR, via Paul Bottiglio and Tim Wiley; The second encore was patched in from a separate soundboard-to-cassette-master-to-CDR source [4]
- **gd1992-05-19.150294.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 6, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [6]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; an UltraMatrix DAT patched some tunings and tape flips [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Cal Expo Amphitheater, May 19, 1992 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/CLX920519.html) [24]
- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Cal Expo Amphitheater, May 19, 1992 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/CLX920519-A.html) [25]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1992-05-19 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1992-05-19-grateful-dead-ticket/) [26]
